Since \(85x+66y\equiv 0 \pmod{100}\), reducing mod 2 gives \(x\equiv 0 \pmod{2}\). So \(x\) must be even.

Try the smallest even \(x=2\):
\[
85(2)+66y \equiv 0 \pmod{100}
\]
\[
170+66y \equiv 0 \pmod{100}
\]
\[
66y \equiv 30 \pmod{100}
\]
Divide by 2:
\[
33y \equiv 15 \pmod{50}
\]
Since \(33^{-1}\equiv 47 \pmod{50}\),
\[
y \equiv 15\cdot 47 \equiv 705 \equiv 5 \pmod{50}.
\]
The smallest \(y\ge 1\) is \(5\).

Thus \(x=2,\ y=5\), giving total stamps:
\[
x+y=7.
\]

\boxed{7}
